title: Ungated wheel policy reads overlay_on, which release builds can still set via the ungated D-key chain — wheel dead-zones over the invisible NOC panel in release
detail: Hoisting camera_wheel_policy out of the gate made release input routing depend on overlay_on — but effect_overlay's comment lies: the D toggle is ungated. Release: D sets overlay_on, camera_wheel_policy returns .Noc_Scroll over NOC_PANEL rect, effect_zoom's gated body compiles to a bare return — zoom silently dies over ~23% of the window.
recommended_fix: Make the comment true: wrap the on_overlay registration (main.odin:388) or the .D mapping in `when #config(PP_DEBUG)`; or pass overlay_on=false in non-PP_DEBUG builds at the effect_zoom policy call.

detail: The feed's window is the frame slice; the core's window is one plan (interval 80 ticks vs 5-tick frame cap — one spawn per frame forever). At interval ≤5 the exclusion diverges from the core's real per-window classification, yielding false SEEDs/pullbacks. Unreachable generality plus an unstated data invariant, nothing asserts it.
recommended_fix: Either drop the window params and the multi-event walk (assert n_spawns ≤ 1 via the interval>max_steps invariant), or document + runtime-assert the invariant the exclusion actually needs: terminal_spawn_interval_ticks > max frame steps.

title: N1 'ONE source' fit claim still false: the fit derivation lives in both view_compute (render) and camera_fit (main)
detail: The r2 N1 fix consolidated main.odin's three sites, but the same expression still exists in view_compute. If the fit rule ever changes (margins, letterboxing), the two must change in lockstep or zoom anchors and clamps drift from the rendered transform.
recommended_fix: Move the fit helper into app/render (view.odin, e.g. view_fit(v)) so view_compute and main's camera math call one proc; then the ONE-source comment is true.
